h1: Custom Bottle Badges for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom bottle badges in bulk. Perfect for branding reusable bottles. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom bottle badges are a focused way to brand reusable water bottles, tumblers, or sports bottles for your team or event. Unlike standard lapel pins, these badges feature a flat back or adhesive backing designed to attach securely to curved surfaces. Choose from enamel or printed designs in metal or PVC, with options for dome coating to protect the artwork. Ideal for corporate gifts, trade show giveaways, or employee recognition, bottle badges keep your logo visible every time someone reaches for a drink.
heroAltText: Custom bottle badges attached to a reusable water bottle, featuring a glossy enamel finish and company logo.
